description: Keep recruiting work moving without switching systems. Find companies, jobs, candidates, and teammates; create and update recruiting records, including jobs with optional city, state, and ZIP details; review schedules, product settings, sales territories, and delivery analytics; and search recruitlayer documentation—all from ChatGPT. Every result and action respects the signed-in user's existing recruitlayer permissions.

defaultPrompt: How can I get more candidates for the last job I posted?
